requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with Increased Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed bottles supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, with CMY bottle size exceeding 8K.
requirements.Rationale: To increase consumable yield, reducing frequency of replacement and supporting higher volume printing environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink formulation compatibility, printer tank design, bottle manufacturing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Bottles are keyed, support 6K Black and 6K CMY yields, and CMY bottle size is >8K; validated in printer system with no compatibility or reliability issues.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Bottle Reliability
requirements.Description: Ensure new bottles and tank system deliver spill-free operation during all user interactions.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user experience and reduce mess/errors during ink refilling.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spillage during normal use and refilling, verified by user testing and reliability assessments.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F (Next-Gen Output Assembly-Filter) with a metal foiled labyrinth and lid label, maintaining existing click-on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances filtration and identification while maintaining established user interface.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F includes metal foiled labyrinth, lid label, and passes functional and assembly tests.

requirements.Title: Support Customer-Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design system so that both PHA (Printhead Assembly) and NOA-F are customer-replaceable parts.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces service costs and downtime, improves customer satisfaction.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can replace PHA and NOA-F with no tools, as validated in usability studies.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Printer and consumables must support a warranty page life of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Supports high-usage environments and competitive positioning.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer and consumables achieve 80K page life in accelerated life testing.

requirements.Title: Reddington ID with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Implement Reddington industrial design (ID) with increased tank size; no changes to Marconi-HI ADF.
requirements.Rationale: Accommodates higher ink volumes while maintaining familiar design language.
requirements.Dependencies: Tank and chassis design, ID approval.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer meets Reddington ID guidelines and increased tank capacity is verified by physical measurement.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental requirements for PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Required for market access and environmental certifications.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes third-party EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel audits.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Modify input and output trays to accommodate tank protrusion and optimize overall size.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures physical compatibility and user convenience.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays fit with tank protrusion, validated in prototype builds.

requirements.Title: 4.3” Color Graphic Display (CGD)
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch color graphic display as the user interface.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances user experience and supports advanced features.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD is functional and passes usability and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station aerosol management to accommodate changes from increased tank size and new spit platform.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and maintains print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol emissions within safe limits, validated in lab tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update carriage dynamic and force models to account for new tube routing and increased weights.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable printhead movement and print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within specified force limits and passes stress testing.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Design paper path to support increased page life of 80K pages.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures durability and reliability over extended printer use.
requirements.Dependencies: Paper path component selection and testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components show no significant wear after 80K pages in accelerated testing.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance Serviceable Part (Post-80K Life)
requirements.Description: Provide an ink maintenance part that is serviceable at service centers after 80K page life.
requirements.Rationale: Supports continued printer operation beyond warranty period.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance part post-80K life; validated by service procedure tests.

requirements.Title: IDS New Make-Break and FI Connection
requirements.Description: Implement new make-break and fluidic interconnect (FI) connection in IDS (Ink Delivery System).
requirements.Rationale: Improves reliability and ease of assembly/servicing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: IDS make-break and FI connections are robust, leak-free, and pass assembly tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new IDS startup algorithm and air management system.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent startup performance and print quality.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup algorithm initializes IDS without airlocks or print defects, as verified in system tests.

requirements.Title: New Print Quality Goals & Depletion Definitions
requirements.Description: Define new print quality (PQ) goals and ink depletion criteria to align with new page yield definitions.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures customer expectations are met for print quality and consumable life.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ and depletion goals are documented and met in system tests.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Hi PDL and Tux dASIC
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Hi PDL and Tux dASIC for the Magellan platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and leverages proven technology.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Marconi Hi PDL and Tux dASIC are integrated and functional in Magellan platform.

requirements.Title: Integration of Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune FW
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware for wireless connectivity and system control.
requirements.Rationale: Supports modern connectivity and feature set.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi and firmware function as specified in all supported use cases.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security Implementation
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures device security and compliance with HP standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All Gauss4.xx security requirements are met and verified by security audit.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Printing as a Service) Enablement
requirements.Description: Enable PaaS business model, supporting consumer, SMB, and enterprise service paths.
requirements.Rationale: Expands revenue streams and adapts to evolving customer needs.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS is operational for all targeted customer segments, validated by service onboarding tests.

requirements.Title: SMB and Enterprise Solution Support
requirements.Description: Integrate SMB manageability and enterprise support, including WJA, HPSM, and JAM solutions.
requirements.Rationale: Meets requirements of business customers for device management and integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Solutions are integrated and pass customer acceptance tests.

requirements.Title: Client & Driver Support Expansion
requirements.Description: Support HPX, PSA, SUPD, UPD, EasyStart, USS, and UFD clients and drivers.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures broad compatibility with user environments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All listed clients and drivers function with Magellan printer as specified.

requirements.Title: Speed: 25/20 ppm (PDL: 25/19 ppm)
requirements.Description: Achieve print speeds of 25/20 pages per minute (ppm), with PDL speeds of 25/19 ppm.
requirements.Rationale: Competitive performance for target market segments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves specified speeds in standardized print tests.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: SuperAmp Printhead Assembly (PHA) must achieve a life of 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliability and reduces maintenance for high-volume users.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes 65K page life tests without failure.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life: 2 Years or Page Count
requirements.Description: Provide a warranty life of 2 years or specified page count, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with market expectations and competitive offerings.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are documented and validated by compliance team.

requirements.Title: Serviceability: Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Ensure maintenance box is serviceable for routine maintenance and part replacement.
requirements.Rationale: Facilitates easy servicing and reduces downtime.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced or serviced by trained personnel; validated by service procedure tests.
